Bloom Energy (formerly, Ion America) is an American public company that designs and manufactures solid oxide fuel cells (SOFCs)
Jun 30, 2023 · Bloom Energy relies on many suppliers to support the production of its solid oxide fuel cells and hydrogen electrolyzers.
